model_annotation: This plot illustrates the sharpness contributions of two models, ViT and ImageNet1k, as a function of training steps. The x-axis, labeled as “Training Steps,” is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 37700, with tick labels spaced by 3010 increments. The y-axis, scaled logarithmically and labeled “Sharpness composition,” ranges from approximately 10<sup>-5</sup> to 10<sup>-1</sup>, with tick labels spaced by factors of 10. The orange line, represented by a solid line, starts near 0 at approximately 7500 training steps and increases to a value around 0.001 at 37700 training steps. The blue line, depicted as a solid line, begins nearly at 0 at approximately 15080 training steps and reaches a value of around 0.0008 at 31600 training steps.
